description: Query, explore, and update databases through existing DataRobot data connections (datastores) with the connection's stored credentials: no connection strings, no app scaffolding. Use when the user wants to list DataRobot data connections, browse schemas, tables, or columns, preview a table, or run a SQL SELECT against any database connected in DataRobot; or run INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE/CREATE (DML/DDL) through a Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, SAP Datasphere, or Trino connection. Examples: "query my Snowflake data connection", "show 10 rows from SALES.ORDERS in datastore <id>", "insert yesterday's totals into daily_summary in my Databricks connection". With only a JDBC URL and credentials, use datarobot-connectivity-jdbc-sql. Creating a connection happens in the DataRobot UI.
